To fix this, the `count` should be incremented in the `pop()` method (when an undo is performed), and not in `push()`. Additionally, the `getUndoCount()` method should return the current `count`. 

Here's the corrected `CellStack` class:

```java
package game;

import game.map.cells.FillableCell;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;

import java.util.Stack;

/**
 * Class encapsulating an undo stack.
 */
class CellStack {

	private final Stack<@NotNull FillableCell> cellStack = new Stack<>();
	private int count = 0;

	/**
	 * @return Number of undos (i.e. {@link CellStack#pop()}) invoked.
	 */
	int getUndoCount() {
		return count;
	}

	/**
	 * Displays the current undo count to {@link System#out}.
	 */
	void display() {
		System.out.println("Undo Count: " + count);
	}

	void push(final FillableCell cell) {
		cellStack.push(cell);
	}

	FillableCell pop() {
		if (cellStack.isEmpty()) {
			return null;
		}
		count++;
		return cellStack.pop();
	}
}
```

The constructor `public Game(int rows, int cols, int delay, Cell[][] cells, List<Pipe> pipes)` initializes the game state by creating the map, setting up the pipe queue, delay bar, and other properties. Here's a brief explanation:

- The `map` should be initialized with the given `cells`.
- The `pipeQueue` should be populated with the provided `pipes`.
- The `delayBar` should be initialized with the given `delay`.
- The `numOfSteps` should be reset to zero.

Below is a complete implementation of the constructor:

```java
public Game(int rows, int cols, int delay, Cell[][] cells, List<Pipe> pipes) {
    // Initialize the map with the provided cells
    this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2);
    for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
        for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
            this.map.setCell(r + 1, c + 1, cells[r][c]);
        }
    }
    // Initialize the pipe queue with the provided pipes
    this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue();
    if (pipes != null) {
        for (Pipe pipe : pipes) {
            this.pipeQueue.enqueue(pipe);
        }
    }
    // Initialize the delay bar with the delay
    this.delayBar = new DelayBar(delay);
    // Reset steps count
    this.numOfSteps = 0;
}
```

This implementation ensures the map is correctly populated, the pipe queue is set up, and the delay bar is initialized, allowing the game to run successfully.

Here's a brief explanation of the implementation:
- Convert the column character to a column index (assuming columns are labeled 'A', 'B', 'C', etc.).
- Create a `Coordinate` object with the given row and column.
- Check if the cell at that coordinate is fillable and empty.
- If so, place the pipe, update the pipe queue, delay bar, cell stack, and increment the step count.
- Return true if placement succeeded, false otherwise.

Below is a complete implementation of the method:

```java
public boolean placePipe(int row, char col) {
    // Convert column character to 0-based index (assuming 'A' -> 0, 'B' -> 1, etc.)
    int colIndex = col - 'A';
    // Convert to 0-based indices for internal map (assuming map indexing starts at 1)
    int mapRow = row;
    int mapCol = colIndex + 1; // since columns are 1-based in the map

    Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(mapRow, mapCol);
    Cell cell = map.getCell(coord);

    // Check if the cell is fillable and empty
    if (cell instanceof FillableCell fillableCell && fillableCell.isEmpty()) {
        // Get the current pipe from the queue
        Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.peek();
        if (currentPipe == null) {
            return false; // No pipe available to place
        }

        // Place the pipe on the map
        boolean placed = map.placePipe(coord, currentPipe);
        if (placed) {
            // Remove the pipe from the queue
            pipeQueue.dequeue();

            // Update delay bar, cell stack, and steps
            delayBar.increment(); // assuming increment method exists
            cellStack.push(cell);
            numOfSteps++;
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}
```

The `skipPipe()` method should advance the pipe queue to the next pipe, effectively skipping the current one. This involves removing the current pipe from the queue and adding it back at the end, so the next pipe becomes active. Additionally, the method should handle the case when there are no pipes to skip.

Here's a complete implementation:

```java
public void skipPipe() {
    Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.peek();
    if (currentPipe != null) {
        pipeQueue.dequeue(); // Remove the current pipe
        pipeQueue.enqueue(currentPipe); // Re-add it at the end to skip
        delayBar.increment(); // Optional: increment delay or steps if needed
    }
}
```

```java
	public void Game(int rows, int cols) {
		this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2);
		this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue();
		this.delayBar = new DelayBar(0);
		this.numOfSteps = 0;
	}

	public void Game(int rows, int cols, int delay, Cell[][] cells, List<Pipe> pipes) {
		this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2);
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				this.map.setCell(r + 1, c + 1, cells[r][c]);
			}
		}
		this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue();
		if (pipes != null) {
			for (Pipe pipe : pipes) {
				this.pipeQueue.enqueue(pipe);
			}
		}
		this.delayBar = new DelayBar(delay);
		this.numOfSteps = 0;
	}

	public boolean placePipe(int row, char col) {
		int colIndex = col - 'A';
		int mapRow = row;
		int mapCol = colIndex + 1;
		Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(mapRow, mapCol);
		Cell cell = map.getCell(coord);
		if (cell instanceof FillableCell fillableCell && fillableCell.isEmpty()) {
			Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.peek();
			if (currentPipe == null) {
				return false;
			}
			boolean placed = map.placePipe(coord, currentPipe);
			if (placed) {
				pipeQueue.dequeue();
				delayBar.increment();
				cellStack.push(cell);
				numOfSteps++;
				return true;
			}
		}
		return false;
	}
```

	public void skipPipe() {
		Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.peek();
		if (currentPipe != null) {
```java
			pipeQueue.dequeue();
			pipeQueue.enqueue(currentPipe);
			delayBar.increment();
		}
	}
```

	public boolean undoStep() {
		if (cellStack.isEmpty()) {
			return false;
		}
		Cell lastCell = cellStack.pop();
```java
		lastCell.restore();
		numOfSteps--;
		return true;
	}
```

	public void updateState() {
		int currentDistance = delayBar.getValue();
		map.fillTiles(currentDistance);
```java
	}
```

	public boolean hasWon() {
		for (Cell cell : map.getCells()) {
			if (cell instanceof FillableCell fillableCell && !fillableCell.isFilled()) {
				return false;
			}
		}
		return true;
	}
}

```java
package game;

import game.map.Map;
import game.map.cells.Cell;
import game.map.cells.FillableCell;
import game.pipes.Pipe;
import io.Deserializer;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import util.Coordinate;

import java.util.List;

public class Game {

	@NotNull
	private final Map map;
	@NotNull
	private final PipeQueue pipeQueue;
	@NotNull
	private final DelayBar delayBar;
	@NotNull
	private final CellStack cellStack = new CellStack();

	private int numOfSteps = 0;

	/**
	 * Creates a game with a given map and various properties.
	 *
	 * <p>
	 * This constructor is a convenience method for unit testing purposes.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @param rows Number of rows of the given map.
	 * @param cols Number of columns of the given map.
	 * @param delay Delay in number of rounds before filling the pipes.
	 * @param cellsRep String representation of the map, with columns delimited by {@code '\n'}.
	 * @param pipes List of pre-generated pipes, if any.
	 * @return A game constructed with the given parameters.
	 */
	@NotNull
	static Game fromString(int rows, int cols, int delay, @NotNull String cellsRep, @Nullable List<Pipe> pipes) {
		var cells = Deserializer.parseString(rows, cols, cellsRep);

		return new Game(rows, cols, delay, cells, pipes);
	}

	/**
	 * Displays the current game state.
	 */
	public void display() {
		map.display();
		System.out.println();
		pipeQueue.display();
		cellStack.display();
		System.out.println();
		delayBar.display();
	}

	/**
	 * @return Number of steps the player has taken.
	 */
	public int getNumOfSteps() {
		// TODO
		return 0;
	}

	public void Game(int rows, int cols) {
		this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2);
		this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue();
		this.delayBar = new DelayBar(0);
		this.numOfSteps = 0;
	}

	public void Game(int rows, int cols, int delay, Cell[][] cells, List<Pipe> pipes) {
		this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2);
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				this.map.setCell(r + 1, c + 1, cells[r][c]);
			}
		}
		this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue();
		if (pipes != null) {
			for (Pipe pipe : pipes) {
				this.pipeQueue.enqueue(pipe);
			}
		}
		this.delayBar = new DelayBar(delay);
		this.numOfSteps = 0;
	}

	public boolean placePipe(int row, char col) {
		int colIndex = col - 'A';
		int mapRow = row;
		int mapCol = colIndex + 1;
		Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(mapRow, mapCol);
		Cell cell = map.getCell(coord);
		if (cell instanceof FillableCell fillableCell && fillableCell.isEmpty()) {
			Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.peek();
			if (currentPipe == null) {
				return false;
			}
			boolean placed = map.placePipe(coord, currentPipe);
			if (placed) {
				pipeQueue.dequeue();
				delayBar.increment();
				cellStack.push(cell);
				numOfSteps++;
				return true;
			}
		}
		return false;
	}

	public void skipPipe() {
		Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.peek();
		if (currentPipe != null) {
			pipeQueue.dequeue();
			pipeQueue.enqueue(currentPipe);
			delayBar.increment();
		}
	}

	public boolean undoStep() {
		if (cellStack.isEmpty()) {
			return false;
		}
		Cell lastCell = cellStack.pop();
		lastCell.restore();
		numOfSteps--;
		return true;
	}

	public void updateState() {
		int currentDistance = delayBar.getValue();
		map.fillTiles(currentDistance);
	}
```

	public boolean hasWon() {
		for (Cell cell : map.getCells()) {
			if (cell instanceof FillableCell fillableCell && !fillableCell.isFilled()) {
				return false;
			}
		}
		return true;
```java
	}
```

	public boolean hasLost() {
		return map.hasLost() || hasWon();
	}
}

```java
package game;

import game.map.Map;
import game.map.cells.Cell;
import game.map.cells.FillableCell;
import game.pipes.Pipe;
import io.Deserializer;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import util.Coordinate;

import java.util.List;

public class Game {

	@NotNull
	private final Map map;
	@NotNull
	private final PipeQueue pipeQueue;
	@NotNull
	private final DelayBar delayBar;
	@NotNull
	private final CellStack cellStack = new CellStack();

	private int numOfSteps = 0;

	/**
	 * Creates a game with a given map and various properties.
	 *
	 * <p>
	 * This constructor is a convenience method for unit testing purposes.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @param rows Number of rows of the given map.
	 * @param cols Number of columns of the given map.
	 * @param delay Delay in number of rounds before filling the pipes.
	 * @param cellsRep String representation of the map, with columns delimited by {@code '\n'}.
	 * @param pipes List of pre-generated pipes, if any.
	 * @return A game constructed with the given parameters.
	 */
	@NotNull
	static Game fromString(int rows, int cols, int delay, @NotNull String cellsRep, @Nullable List<Pipe> pipes) {
		var cells = Deserializer.parseString(rows, cols, cellsRep);

		return new Game(rows, cols, delay, cells, pipes);
	}

	/**
	 * Displays the current game state.
	 */
	public void display() {
		map.display();
		System.out.println();
		pipeQueue.display();
		cellStack.display();
		System.out.println();
		delayBar.display();
	}

	/**
	 * @return Number of steps the player has taken.
	 */
	public int getNumOfSteps() {
		// TODO
		return 0;
	}

	public void Game(int rows, int cols) {
		this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2);
		this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue();
		this.delayBar = new DelayBar(0);
		this.numOfSteps = 0;
	}

	public void Game(int rows, int cols, int delay, Cell[][] cells, List<Pipe> pipes) {
		this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2);
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				this.map.setCell(r + 1, c + 1, cells[r][c]);
			}
		}
		this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue();
		if (pipes != null) {
			for (Pipe pipe : pipes) {
				this.pipeQueue.enqueue(pipe);
			}
		}
		this.delayBar = new DelayBar(delay);
		this.numOfSteps = 0;
	}

	public boolean placePipe(int row, char col) {
		int colIndex = col - 'A';
		int mapRow = row;
		int mapCol = colIndex + 1;
		Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(mapRow, mapCol);
		Cell cell = map.getCell(coord);
		if (cell instanceof FillableCell fillableCell && fillableCell.isEmpty()) {
			Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.peek();
			if (currentPipe == null) {
				return false;
			}
			boolean placed = map.placePipe(coord, currentPipe);
			if (placed) {
				pipeQueue.dequeue();
				delayBar.increment();
				cellStack.push(cell);
				numOfSteps++;
				return true;
			}
		}
		return false;
	}

	public void skipPipe() {
		Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.peek();
		if (currentPipe != null) {
			pipeQueue.dequeue();
			pipeQueue.enqueue(currentPipe);
			delayBar.increment();
		}
	}

	public boolean undoStep() {
		if (cellStack.isEmpty()) {
			return false;
		}
		Cell lastCell = cellStack.pop();
		lastCell.restore();
		numOfSteps--;
		return true;
	}

	public void updateState() {
		int currentDistance = delayBar.getValue();
		map.fillTiles(currentDistance);
	}

	public boolean hasWon() {
		for (Cell cell : map.getCells()) {
			if (cell instanceof FillableCell fillableCell && !fillableCell.isFilled()) {
				return false;
			}
		}
		return true;
	}
```

	public boolean hasLost() {
		return map.hasLost() || hasWon();
```java
	}
```
}

```java
package game;

import game.map.Map;

import java.util.List;

public class Game {

    private final Map map;
    @NotNull
    private final PipeQueue pipeQueue;
    @NotNull
    private final DelayBar delayBar;
    @NotNull
    private final CellStack cellStack = new CellStack();

    private int numOfSteps = 0;

    /**
     * Creates a game with a given map and various properties.
     *
     * <p>
     * This constructor is a convenience method for unit testing purposes.
     * </p>
     *
     * @param rows Number of rows of the given map.
     * @param cols Number of columns of the given map.
     */
```
```java
    public Game(int rows, int cols) {
        this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2);
        this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue();
        this.delayBar = new DelayBar(0);
        this.numOfSteps = 0;
    }

    /**
     * Creates a game with specified parameters.
     *
     * @param rows Number of rows.
     * @param cols Number of columns.
     * @param delay Delay in rounds.
     * @param cells 2D array of cells.
     * @param pipes List of pipes.
     */
    public Game(int rows, int cols, int delay, Cell[][] cells, List<Pipe> pipes) {
        this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2);
        for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
            for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {

            }

        this.numOfSteps = 0;
```

```java
public Map(int rows, int cols) {
    this.rows = rows;
    this.cols = cols;
    this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];

    // Initialize all cells as FillableCell (or empty cells)
    for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
        for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
            cells[r][c] = new FillableCell(); // or new Cell() if default
        }
    }

    // Generate source cell in a non-edge position
    TerminationCell.CreateInfo sourceInfo = generateStartCellInfo();
    Coordinate sourceCoord = sourceInfo.coord;
    Direction sourceDirection = sourceInfo.direction;

    // Create and assign source cell
    sourceCell = new TerminationCell(sourceCoord, sourceDirection, true);
    cells[sourceCoord.row][sourceCoord.col] = sourceCell;

    // Generate sink cell on an edge, pointing outside
    TerminationCell.CreateInfo sinkInfo = generateEndCellInfo();
    Coordinate sinkCoord = sinkInfo.coord;
    Direction sinkDirection = sinkInfo.direction;

    // Create and assign sink cell
    sinkCell = new TerminationCell(sinkCoord, sinkDirection, false);
    cells[sinkCoord.row][sinkCoord.col] = sinkCell;
```
```java
}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateStartCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			int row = rng.nextInt(rows);
			int col = rng.nextInt(cols);
			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			int dir = rng.nextInt(4);
			direction = Direction.values()[dir];

			if (row == 0 || row == rows - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			if (col == 0 || col == cols - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			switch (direction) {
			case UP:
				if (row <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case DOWN:
				if (row >= rows - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case LEFT:
				if (col <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case RIGHT:
				if (col >= cols - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
			int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

		final int padLength = Integer.valueOf(rows - 1).toString().length();

		Runnable printColumns = () -> {

				System.out.print((char) ('A' + i));

			System.out.println();

		printColumns.run();

		for (int i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(String.format("%1$" + padLength + "s", i));
			} else {
				System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));
			}

			Arrays.stream(cells[i]).forEachOrdered(elem -> System.out.print(elem.toSingleChar()));

			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(i);
			}

			System.out.println();
		}

		printColumns.run();
	}
```

The task is to implement the constructor `public Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells)` that initializes the Map object with the provided cells array, ensuring the constraints about source and sink placement are met. The constructor should assign the parameters to the class fields, validate the map according to the rules, and set the source and sink cells accordingly.

**Explanation:**
- Assign `rows`, `cols`, and `cells` to the class fields.
- Verify that there is exactly one source cell in a non-edge cell and one sink cell on an edge cell.
- Ensure the source cell does not point into a wall.
- Ensure the sink cell points outside the map.
- Identify and assign `sourceCell` and `sinkCell` references.

**Proposed code:**

```java
public Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) {
    this.rows = rows;
    this.cols = cols;
    this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];

    // Copy the provided cells into the class field
    for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
        System.arraycopy(cells[r], 0, this.cells[r], 0, cols);
    }

    // Initialize source and sink references
    sourceCell = null;
    sinkCell = null;

    int sourceCount = 0;
    int sinkCount = 0;

    // Validate and identify source and sink cells
    for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
        for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
            Cell cell = this.cells[r][c];

            if (cell instanceof TerminationCell termCell) {
                if (termCell.isSource()) {
                    sourceCount++;
                    sourceCell = termCell;
                    // Check source is not on edge
                    if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source must not be on edge");
                    }
                    // Check source does not point into a wall
                    Direction dir = termCell.getDirection();
                    Coordinate nextCoord = new Coordinate(r, c).add(dir.getOffset());
                    if (isInBounds(nextCoord)) {
                        Cell nextCell = this.cells[nextCoord.row][nextCoord.col];
                        if (nextCell instanceof Wall) {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source cannot point into a wall");
                        }
                    }
                } else {
                    // Check sink is on edge
                    if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
                        sinkCount++;
                        sinkCell = termCell;
                        // Check sink points outside the map
                        Direction dir = termCell.getDirection();
                        Coordinate nextCoord = new Coordinate(r, c).add(dir.getOffset());
                        if (isInBounds(nextCoord)) {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink must point outside the map");
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if (sourceCount != 1) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("There must be exactly one source cell");
    }
    if (sinkCount != 1) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("There must be exactly one sink cell");
    }
}

// Helper method to check if coordinate is within bounds
private boolean isInBounds(@NotNull Coordinate coord) {
    return coord.row >= 0 && coord.row < rows && coord.col >= 0 && coord.col < cols;
}
```

```java
	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateStartCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			int row = rng.nextInt(rows);
			int col = rng.nextInt(cols);
			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			int dir = rng.nextInt(4);
			direction = Direction.values()[dir];

			if (row == 0 || row == rows - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			if (col == 0 || col == cols - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			switch (direction) {
			case UP:
				if (row <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case DOWN:
				if (row >= rows - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case LEFT:
				if (col <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case RIGHT:
				if (col >= cols - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
			int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	/**
	 * Displays the current map.

	public void display() {
		final int padLength = Integer.valueOf(rows - 1).toString().length();

		Runnable printColumns = () -> {
			System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));
			System.out.print(' ');
			for (int i = 0; i < cols - 2; ++i) {
				System.out.print((char) ('A' + i));
			}
			System.out.println();
		};

		printColumns.run();

		for (int i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(String.format("%1$" + padLength + "s", i));
			} else {
				System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));
			}

			Arrays.stream(cells[i]).forEachOrdered(elem -> System.out.print(elem.toSingleChar()));

			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(i);
			}

			System.out.println();
		}

		printColumns.run();
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols) {
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				cells[r][c] = new FillableCell();
			}
		}
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sourceInfo = generateStartCellInfo();
		Coordinate sourceCoord = sourceInfo.coord;
		Direction sourceDirection = sourceInfo.direction;
		sourceCell = new TerminationCell(sourceCoord, sourceDirection, true);
		cells[sourceCoord.row][sourceCoord.col] = sourceCell;
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sinkInfo = generateEndCellInfo();
		Coordinate sinkCoord = sinkInfo.coord;
		Direction sinkDirection = sinkInfo.direction;
		sinkCell = new TerminationCell(sinkCoord, sinkDirection, false);
		cells[sinkCoord.row][sinkCoord.col] = sinkCell;
	}
```

public Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) {
    this.rows = rows;
    this.cols = cols;
    this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];

    // Copy the provided cells into the class field
    for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
        System.arraycopy(cells[r], 0, this.cells[r], 0, cols);
    }

    // Initialize source and sink references
    sourceCell = null;
    sinkCell = null;

    int sourceCount = 0;
    int sinkCount = 0;

    // Validate and identify source and sink cells
    for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
        for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
            Cell cell = this.cells[r][c];

            if (cell instanceof TerminationCell termCell) {
                if (termCell.isSource()) {
                    sourceCount++;
                    sourceCell = termCell;
                    // Check source is not on edge
                    if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source must not be on edge");
                    }
                    // Check source does not point into a wall
                    Direction dir = termCell.getDirection();
                    Coordinate nextCoord = new Coordinate(r, c).add(dir.getOffset());
                    if (isInBounds(nextCoord)) {
                        Cell nextCell = this.cells[nextCoord.row][nextCoord.col];
                        if (nextCell instanceof Wall) {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source cannot point into a wall");
                        }
                    }
                } else {
                    // Check sink is on edge
                    if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
                        sinkCount++;
                        sinkCell = termCell;
                        // Check sink points outside the map
                        Direction dir = termCell.getDirection();
                        Coordinate nextCoord = new Coordinate(r, c).add(dir.getOffset());
                        if (isInBounds(nextCoord)) {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink must point outside the map");
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if (sourceCount != 1) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("There must be exactly one source cell");
    }
    if (sinkCount != 1) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("There must be exactly one sink cell");
    }

The `tryPlacePipe` method should verify that the specified coordinates are within bounds, that the target cell is a `FillableCell`, and that it is unoccupied (i.e., not already containing a pipe). If all conditions are met, it places the pipe and returns `true`; otherwise, it returns `false`.

```java
boolean tryPlacePipe(int row, int col, Pipe p) {
    // Convert to zero-based indices
    int r = row - 1;
    int c = col - 1;

    // Check bounds
    if (r < 0 || r >= rows || c < 0 || c >= cols) {
        return false;
    }

    Cell targetCell = cells[r][c];

    // Check if cell is fillable and unoccupied
    if (targetCell instanceof FillableCell fillable && !fillable.isOccupied()) {
        fillable.setPipe(p);
        return true;
    }

    // Cannot place pipe
    return false;
}
```

```java
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

		for (int i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(String.format("%1$" + padLength + "s", i));

			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(i);
			}

			System.out.println();
		}

		printColumns.run();
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols) {
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				cells[r][c] = new FillableCell();
			}
		}
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sourceInfo = generateStartCellInfo();
		Coordinate sourceCoord = sourceInfo.coord;
		Direction sourceDirection = sourceInfo.direction;
		sourceCell = new TerminationCell(sourceCoord, sourceDirection, true);
		cells[sourceCoord.row][sourceCoord.col] = sourceCell;
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sinkInfo = generateEndCellInfo();
		Coordinate sinkCoord = sinkInfo.coord;
		Direction sinkDirection = sinkInfo.direction;
		sinkCell = new TerminationCell(sinkCoord, sinkDirection, false);
		cells[sinkCoord.row][sinkCoord.col] = sinkCell;
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) {
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			System.arraycopy(cells[r], 0, this.cells[r], 0, cols);
		}
		sourceCell = null;
		sinkCell = null;
		int sourceCount = 0;
		int sinkCount = 0;
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				Cell cell = this.cells[r][c];
				if (cell instanceof TerminationCell termCell) {
					if (termCell.isSource()) {
						sourceCount++;
						sourceCell = termCell;
						if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source must not be on edge");
						}
						Direction dir = termCell.getDirection();
						Coordinate nextCoord = new Coordinate(r, c).add(dir.getOffset());
						if (isInBounds(nextCoord)) {
							Cell nextCell = this.cells[nextCoord.row][nextCoord.col];
							if (nextCell instanceof Wall) {
								throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source cannot point into a wall");
							}
						}
					} else {
						if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
							sinkCount++;
							sinkCell = termCell;
							Direction dir = termCell.getDirection();
							Coordinate nextCoord = new Coordinate(r, c).add(dir.getOffset());
							if (isInBounds(nextCoord)) {
								throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink must point outside the map");
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if (sourceCount != 1) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("There must be exactly one source cell");
		}
		if (sinkCount != 1) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("There must be exactly one sink cell");
		}
	}
```

```java
	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateStartCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			int row = rng.nextInt(rows);
			int col = rng.nextInt(cols);
			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			int dir = rng.nextInt(4);
			direction = Direction.values()[dir];

			if (row == 0 || row == rows - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			if (col == 0 || col == cols - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			switch (direction) {
			case UP:
				if (row <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case DOWN:
				if (row >= rows - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case LEFT:
				if (col <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case RIGHT:
				if (col >= cols - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
			int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) {
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			System.arraycopy(cells[r], 0, this.cells[r], 0, cols);
		}
		sourceCell = null;
		sinkCell = null;
		int sourceCount = 0;
		int sinkCount = 0;
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {

				Cell cell = this.cells[r][c];
				if (cell instanceof TerminationCell termCell) {
					if (termCell.isSource()) {
						sourceCount++;
						sourceCell = termCell;
						if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source must not be on edge");
						}
						Direction dir = termCell.getDirection();
						Coordinate nextCoord = new Coordinate(r, c).add(dir.getOffset());
						if (isInBounds(nextCoord)) {
							Cell nextCell = this.cells[nextCoord.row][nextCoord.col];
							if (nextCell instanceof Wall) {
								throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source cannot point into a wall");
							}
						}
					} else {
						if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
							sinkCount++;
							sinkCell = termCell;

							if (isInBounds(nextCoord)) {
								throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink must point outside the map");
							}
						}
					}

		}
		if (sinkCount != 1) {

		}
```

The `fillTiles` method should fill all cells within the specified `distance` from the `sourceCell`. A common approach is to perform a Breadth-First Search (BFS) starting from the source, tracking the distance from the source cell to each reachable cell, and filling those within the given distance.

Here's a complete implementation:

```java
public void fillTiles(int distance) {
    if (sourceCell == null) {
        return; // No source to start from
    }

    // Clear previous filled tiles if needed
    filledTiles.clear();

    Queue<Coordinate> queue = new LinkedList<>();
    Map<Coordinate, Integer> distanceMap = new HashMap<>();

    Coordinate start = sourceCell.coord;
    queue.offer(start);
    distanceMap.put(start, 0);
    filledTiles.add(start);
    // Mark the source cell as filled
    cells[start.row][start.col].setFilled();

    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();
        int currentDist = distanceMap.get(current);

        if (currentDist >= distance) {
            continue; // Reached max distance
        }

        for (Direction dir : Direction.values()) {
            Coordinate neighbor = current.add(dir.getOffset());
            if (isInBounds(neighbor) && !filledTiles.contains(neighbor)) {
                Cell neighborCell = cells[neighbor.row][neighbor.col];
                if (!(neighborCell instanceof Wall)) {
                    // Fill the neighbor cell
                    neighborCell.setFilled();
                    filledTiles.add(neighbor);
                    distanceMap.put(neighbor, currentDist + 1);
                    queue.offer(neighbor);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

// Helper method to check bounds
private boolean isInBounds(@NotNull Coordinate coord) {
    return coord.row >= 0 && coord.row < rows && coord.col >= 0 && coord.col < cols;
}
```

This implementation ensures all reachable tiles within the given distance are filled appropriately.

```java
	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateStartCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			int row = rng.nextInt(rows);
			int col = rng.nextInt(cols);
			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			int dir = rng.nextInt(4);
			direction = Direction.values()[dir];

			if (row == 0 || row == rows - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			if (col == 0 || col == cols - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			switch (direction) {
			case UP:
				if (row <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case DOWN:
				if (row >= rows - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case LEFT:
				if (col <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case RIGHT:
				if (col >= cols - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
			int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(i);
			}

			System.out.println();
		}

		printColumns.run();
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols) {
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				cells[r][c] = new FillableCell();
			}
		}
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sourceInfo = generateStartCellInfo();
		Coordinate sourceCoord = sourceInfo.coord;
		Direction sourceDirection = sourceInfo.direction;
		sourceCell = new TerminationCell(sourceCoord, sourceDirection, true);
		cells[sourceCoord.row][sourceCoord.col] = sourceCell;
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sinkInfo = generateEndCellInfo();
		Coordinate sinkCoord = sinkInfo.coord;
		Direction sinkDirection = sinkInfo.direction;
		sinkCell = new TerminationCell(sinkCoord, sinkDirection, false);
		cells[sinkCoord.row][sinkCoord.col] = sinkCell;
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) {
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			System.arraycopy(cells[r], 0, this.cells[r], 0, cols);
		}
		sourceCell = null;
		sinkCell = null;
		int sourceCount = 0;
		int sinkCount = 0;
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				Cell cell = this.cells[r][c];
				if (cell instanceof TerminationCell termCell) {
					if (termCell.isSource()) {
						sourceCount++;
						sourceCell = termCell;
						if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source must not be on edge");
						}
						Direction dir = termCell.getDirection();
						Coordinate nextCoord = new Coordinate(r, c).add(dir.getOffset());
						if (isInBounds(nextCoord)) {
							Cell nextCell = this.cells[nextCoord.row][nextCoord.col];
							if (nextCell instanceof Wall) {
								throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source cannot point into a wall");
							}
						}
					} else {
						if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
							sinkCount++;
							sinkCell = termCell;
							Direction dir = termCell.getDirection();
							Coordinate nextCoord = new Coordinate(r, c).add(dir.getOffset());
							if (isInBounds(nextCoord)) {
								throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink must point outside the map");
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if (sourceCount != 1) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("There must be exactly one source cell");
		}
		if (sinkCount != 1) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("There must be exactly one sink cell");
		}
	}

	boolean tryPlacePipe(int row, int col, Pipe p) {
		int r = row - 1;
		int c = col - 1;
		if (r < 0 || r >= rows || c < 0 || c >= cols) {
			return false;
		}
		Cell targetCell = cells[r][c];
		if (targetCell instanceof FillableCell fillable && !fillable.isOccupied()) {
			fillable.setPipe(p);
			return true;
		}
		return false;
	}

	public void undo(final Coordinate coord) {
		int r = coord.row;
		int c = coord.col;
		if (!isInBounds(coord)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Coordinate out of bounds");
		}
		Cell currentCell = cells[r][c];
		if (!(currentCell instanceof FillableCell)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cell is not fillable");
		}
		cells[r][c] = new FillableCell();
		filledTiles.remove(coord);
	}
}
```

Response Text:---
The `checkPath()` method should perform a Breadth-First Search (BFS) starting from the source cell to determine if there's a valid path to the sink cell along the pipes. It should consider only cells that are connected via pipes or are the source/sink, and ignore walls or unfilled cells that are not part of the path.

Here's a complete implementation of the `checkPath()` method:

```java
public boolean checkPath() {
    if (sourceCell == null || sinkCell == null) {
        return false;
    }

    Set<Coordinate> visited = new HashSet<>();
    Queue<Coordinate> queue = new LinkedList<>();
    queue.offer(sourceCell.coord);
    visited.add(sourceCell.coord);

    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();

        if (current.equals(sinkCell.coord)) {
            return true; // Path found
        }

        Cell currentCell = cells[current.row][current.col];

        // Determine the directions to explore based on the current cell's pipes
        List<Direction> directions = new ArrayList<>();

        if (currentCell instanceof Pipe pipe) {
            directions.addAll(pipe.getConnectedDirections());
        } else if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell termCell) {
            directions.add(termCell.getDirection());
        } else {
            continue; // Skip non-pipe, non-termination cells
        }

        for (Direction dir : directions) {
            Coordinate neighbor = current.add(dir.getOffset());
            if (isInBounds(neighbor) && !visited.contains(neighbor)) {
                Cell neighborCell = cells[neighbor.row][neighbor.col];

                // Check if neighbor is connected via pipe
                boolean connected = false;

                if (neighborCell instanceof Pipe neighborPipe) {
                    // Check if neighbor pipe connects back to current
                    if (neighborPipe.getConnectedDirections().contains(dir.getOpposite())) {
                        connected = true;
                    }
                } else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell neighborTerm) {
                    // Check if termination cell is the sink and direction matches
                    if (neighborTerm.equals(sinkCell) && neighborTerm.getDirection() == dir) {
                        connected = true;
                    }
                }

                if (connected) {
                    visited.add(neighbor);
                    queue.offer(neighbor);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    return false; // No path found
}
```

**Explanation:**
- Starts BFS from the source cell.
- Uses a queue to traverse connected cells.
- Checks only cells that are pipes or termination cells.
- Ensures connections are valid by verifying that pipes connect in both directions.
- Returns `true` if the sink cell is reached; otherwise, `false`.

This implementation ensures the path is valid according to the pipe connections and the game rules.

```java
	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateStartCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			int row = rng.nextInt(rows);
			int col = rng.nextInt(cols);
			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			int dir = rng.nextInt(4);
			direction = Direction.values()[dir];

			if (row == 0 || row == rows - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			if (col == 0 || col == cols - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			switch (direction) {
			case UP:
				if (row <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case DOWN:
				if (row >= rows - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case LEFT:
				if (col <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case RIGHT:
				if (col >= cols - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
			int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	public void display() {
		final int padLength = Integer.valueOf(rows - 1).toString().length();

		Runnable printColumns = () -> {
			System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));
			System.out.print(' ');
			for (int i = 0; i < cols - 2; ++i) {
				System.out.print((char) ('A' + i));
			}
			System.out.println();
		};

		printColumns.run();

		for (int i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(String.format("%1$" + padLength + "s", i));
			} else {
				System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));
			}

			Arrays.stream(cells[i]).forEachOrdered(elem -> System.out.print(elem.toSingleChar()));

			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(i);
			}

			System.out.println();
		}

		printColumns.run();
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols) {
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				cells[r][c] = new FillableCell();
			}
		}
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sourceInfo = generateStartCellInfo();
		Coordinate sourceCoord = sourceInfo.coord;
		Direction sourceDirection = sourceInfo.direction;
		sourceCell = new TerminationCell(sourceCoord, sourceDirection, true);
		cells[sourceCoord.row][sourceCoord.col] = sourceCell;
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sinkInfo = generateEndCellInfo();
		Coordinate sinkCoord = sinkInfo.coord;
		Direction sinkDirection = sinkInfo.direction;
		sinkCell = new TerminationCell(sinkCoord, sinkDirection, false);
		cells[sinkCoord.row][sinkCoord.col] = sinkCell;
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) {
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			System.arraycopy(cells[r], 0, this.cells[r], 0, cols);
		}
		sourceCell = null;
		sinkCell = null;
		int sourceCount = 0;
		int sinkCount = 0;
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				Cell cell = this.cells[r][c];
				if (cell instanceof TerminationCell termCell) {
					if (termCell.isSource()) {
						sourceCount++;
						sourceCell = termCell;
						if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source must not be on edge");
						}
						Direction dir = termCell.getDirection();
						Coordinate nextCoord = new Coordinate(r, c).add(dir.getOffset());
						if (isInBounds(nextCoord)) {
							Cell nextCell = this.cells[nextCoord.row][nextCoord.col];
							if (nextCell instanceof Wall) {
								throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source cannot point into a wall");
							}
						}
					} else {
						if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
							sinkCount++;
							sinkCell = termCell;
							Direction dir = termCell.getDirection();
							Coordinate nextCoord = new Coordinate(r, c).add(dir.getOffset());
							if (isInBounds(nextCoord)) {
								throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink must point outside the map");
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if (sourceCount != 1) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("There must be exactly one source cell");
		}
		if (sinkCount != 1) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("There must be exactly one sink cell");
		}
	}

	boolean tryPlacePipe(int row, int col, Pipe p) {
		int r = row - 1;
		int c = col - 1;
		if (r < 0 || r >= rows || c < 0 || c >= cols) {
			return false;
		}
		Cell targetCell = cells[r][c];
		if (targetCell instanceof FillableCell fillable && !fillable.isOccupied()) {
			fillable.setPipe(p);
			return true;
		}
		return false;
	}

	public void undo(final Coordinate coord) {
		int r = coord.row;
		int c = coord.col;
		if (!isInBounds(coord)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Coordinate out of bounds");
		}
		Cell currentCell = cells[r][c];
		if (!(currentCell instanceof FillableCell)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cell is not fillable");
		}
		cells[r][c] = new FillableCell();
		filledTiles.remove(coord);
	}

	public void fillTiles(int distance) {
		if (sourceCell == null) {
			return;
		}
		filledTiles.clear();
		Queue<Coordinate> queue = new LinkedList<>();
		Map<Coordinate, Integer> distanceMap = new HashMap<>();
		Coordinate start = sourceCell.coord;
		queue.offer(start);
		distanceMap.put(start, 0);
		filledTiles.add(start);
		cells[start.row][start.col].setFilled();
		while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
			Coordinate current = queue.poll();
			int currentDist = distanceMap.get(current);
			if (currentDist >= distance) {
				continue;
			}
			for (Direction dir : Direction.values()) {
				Coordinate neighbor = current.add(dir.getOffset());
				if (isInBounds(neighbor) && !filledTiles.contains(neighbor)) {
					Cell neighborCell = cells[neighbor.row][neighbor.col];
					if (!(neighborCell instanceof Wall)) {
						neighborCell.setFilled();
						filledTiles.add(neighbor);
						distanceMap.put(neighbor, currentDist + 1);
						queue.offer(neighbor);
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
```

    Set<Coordinate> visited = new HashSet<>();
    Queue<Coordinate> queue = new LinkedList<>();
    queue.offer(sourceCell.coord);
    visited.add(sourceCell.coord);

    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();

        if (current.equals(sinkCell.coord)) {
            return true; // Path found
        }

        Cell currentCell = cells[current.row][current.col];

        // Determine the directions to explore based on the current cell's pipes
        List<Direction> directions = new ArrayList<>();

        if (currentCell instanceof Pipe pipe) {
            directions.addAll(pipe.getConnectedDirections());
        } else if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell termCell) {

The method `hasLost()` should determine if the game is lost based on whether any pipes were filled during the last round. According to the hint, the game is lost when a round ends and no pipes are filled during that round. 

To implement this, we can compare the number of filled tiles before and after the last fill operation. If no new tiles were filled during the last fill, it indicates that no pipes were filled during that round, and the game is lost.

Here's a complete implementation:

```java
public boolean hasLost() {
    int currentFilledCount = filledTiles.size();
    boolean noNewTilesFilled = currentFilledCount == prevFilledTiles;
    // Update prevFilledTiles for the next round
    prevFilledTiles = currentFilledCount;
    return noNewTilesFilled;
}
```

**Explanation:**
- `filledTiles.size()` gives the current number of filled tiles.
- `prevFilledTiles` stores the count from the previous round.
- If both are equal, no new tiles were filled during the last round, meaning the game is lost.
- We update `prevFilledTiles` at the end to prepare for the next check.

This approach relies on maintaining `prevFilledTiles` across rounds, which is already a class member, aligning with the existing code structure.

```java
		printColumns.run();

		for (int i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(String.format("%1$" + padLength + "s", i));
			} else {
				System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));
			}

			Arrays.stream(cells[i]).forEachOrdered(elem -> System.out.print(elem.toSingleChar()));

			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(i);
			}

			System.out.println();
		}

		printColumns.run();
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols) {
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				cells[r][c] = new FillableCell();
			}
		}
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sourceInfo = generateStartCellInfo();
		Coordinate sourceCoord = sourceInfo.coord;
		Direction sourceDirection = sourceInfo.direction;
		sourceCell = new TerminationCell(sourceCoord, sourceDirection, true);
		cells[sourceCoord.row][sourceCoord.col] = sourceCell;
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sinkInfo = generateEndCellInfo();
		Coordinate sinkCoord = sinkInfo.coord;
		Direction sinkDirection = sinkInfo.direction;
		sinkCell = new TerminationCell(sinkCoord, sinkDirection, false);
		cells[sinkCoord.row][sinkCoord.col] = sinkCell;
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) {
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			System.arraycopy(cells[r], 0, this.cells[r], 0, cols);
		}
		sourceCell = null;
		sinkCell = null;
		int sourceCount = 0;
		int sinkCount = 0;
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				Cell cell = this.cells[r][c];
				if (cell instanceof TerminationCell termCell) {
					if (termCell.isSource()) {
						sourceCount++;
						sourceCell = termCell;
						if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source must not be on edge");
						}
						Direction dir = termCell.getDirection();
						Coordinate nextCoord = new Coordinate(r, c).add(dir.getOffset());
						if (isInBounds(nextCoord)) {
							Cell nextCell = this.cells[nextCoord.row][nextCoord.col];
							if (nextCell instanceof Wall) {
								throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source cannot point into a wall");
							}
						}
					} else {
						if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
							sinkCount++;
							sinkCell = termCell;
							Direction dir = termCell.getDirection();
							Coordinate nextCoord = new Coordinate(r, c).add(dir.getOffset());
							if (isInBounds(nextCoord)) {
								throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink must point outside the map");
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if (sourceCount != 1) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("There must be exactly one source cell");
		}
		if (sinkCount != 1) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("There must be exactly one sink cell");
		}
	}

	boolean tryPlacePipe(int row, int col, Pipe p) {
		int r = row - 1;
		int c = col - 1;
		if (r < 0 || r >= rows || c < 0 || c >= cols) {
			return false;
		}
		Cell targetCell = cells[r][c];
		if (targetCell instanceof FillableCell fillable && !fillable.isOccupied()) {
			fillable.setPipe(p);
			return true;
		}
		return false;
	}

	public void undo(final Coordinate coord) {
		int r = coord.row;
		int c = coord.col;
		if (!isInBounds(coord)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Coordinate out of bounds");
		}
		Cell currentCell = cells[r][c];
		if (!(currentCell instanceof FillableCell)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cell is not fillable");
		}
		cells[r][c] = new FillableCell();
		filledTiles.remove(coord);
	}

	public void fillTiles(int distance) {
		if (sourceCell == null) {
			return;
		}
		filledTiles.clear();
		Queue<Coordinate> queue = new LinkedList<>();
		Map<Coordinate, Integer> distanceMap = new HashMap<>();
		Coordinate start = sourceCell.coord;
		queue.offer(start);
		distanceMap.put(start, 0);
		filledTiles.add(start);
		cells[start.row][start.col].setFilled();
		while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
			Coordinate current = queue.poll();
			int currentDist = distanceMap.get(current);
			if (currentDist >= distance) {
				continue;
			}
			for (Direction dir : Direction.values()) {
				Coordinate neighbor = current.add(dir.getOffset());
				if (isInBounds(neighbor) && !filledTiles.contains(neighbor)) {
					Cell neighborCell = cells[neighbor.row][neighbor.col];
					if (!(neighborCell instanceof Wall)) {
						neighborCell.setFilled();
						filledTiles.add(neighbor);
						distanceMap.put(neighbor, currentDist + 1);
						queue.offer(neighbor);
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public boolean checkPath() {
		if (sourceCell == null || sinkCell == null) {
			return false;
		}
		Set<Coordinate> visited = new HashSet<>();
		Queue<Coordinate> queue = new LinkedList<>();
		queue.offer(sourceCell.coord);
		visited.add(sourceCell.coord);
		while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
			Coordinate current = queue.poll();
			if (current.equals(sinkCell.coord)) {
				return true;
			}
			Cell currentCell = cells[current.row][current.col];
			List<Direction> directions = new ArrayList<>();
			if (currentCell instanceof Pipe pipe) {
				directions.addAll(pipe.getConnectedDirections());
			} else if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell termCell) {
				directions.add(termCell.getDirection());
			} else {
				continue;
			}
			for (Direction dir : directions) {
				Coordinate neighbor = current.add(dir.getOffset());
				if (isInBounds(neighbor) && !visited.contains(neighbor)) {
					Cell neighborCell = cells[neighbor.row][neighbor.col];
					boolean connected = false;
					if (neighborCell instanceof Pipe neighborPipe) {
						if (neighborPipe.getConnectedDirections().contains(dir.getOpposite())) {
							connected = true;
						}
					} else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell neighborTerm) {
						if (neighborTerm.equals(sinkCell) && neighborTerm.getDirection() == dir) {
							connected = true;
						}
					}
					if (connected) {
						visited.add(neighbor);
						queue.offer(neighbor);
					}
				}
			}
		}
		return false;
	}
}
```

```java
package game.map;

import game.map.cells.Cell;
import game.map.cells.FillableCell;
import game.map.cells.TerminationCell;
import game.map.cells.Wall;
import game.pipes.Pipe;
import io.Deserializer;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import util.Coordinate;
import util.Direction;
import util.StringUtils;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * Map of the game.
 */
public class Map {

	private final int rows;
	private final int cols;
	@NotNull
	final Cell[][] cells;

	private TerminationCell sourceCell;
	private TerminationCell sinkCell;

	@NotNull
	private final Set<Coordinate> filledTiles = new HashSet<>();
	private int prevFilledTiles = 0;
	private Integer prevFilledDistance;

	/**
	 * Constructs a map from a map string.
	 * <p>
	 * This is a convenience method for unit testing.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @param rows     Number of rows.
	 * @param cols     Number of columns.
	 * @param cellsRep String representation of the map, with columns delimited by {@code '\n'}.
	 * @return A map with the cells set from {@code cellsRep}.
	 * @throws IllegalArgumentException If the map is incorrectly formatted.
	 */
	@NotNull
	static Map fromString(int rows, int cols, @NotNull String cellsRep) {
		var cells = Deserializer.parseString(rows, cols, cellsRep);

		return new Map(rows, cols, cells);
	}

	/**
	 * Tries to place a pipe at (row, col).
	 *
	 * @param coord Coordinate to place pipe at.
	 * @param pipe  Pipe to place in cell.
	 * @return {@code true} if the pipe is placed in the cell, {@code false} otherwise.
	 */
	public boolean tryPlacePipe(@NotNull final Coordinate coord, @NotNull final Pipe pipe) {
		return tryPlacePipe(coord.row, coord.col, pipe);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateStartCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			int row = rng.nextInt(rows);
			int col = rng.nextInt(cols);
			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			int dir = rng.nextInt(4);
			direction = Direction.values()[dir];

			if (row == 0 || row == rows - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			if (col == 0 || col == cols - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			switch (direction) {
			case UP:
				if (row <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case DOWN:
				if (row >= rows - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case LEFT:
				if (col <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case RIGHT:
				if (col >= cols - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
			int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	/**
	 * Displays the current map.
	 */
	public void display() {
		final int padLength = Integer.valueOf(rows - 1).toString().length();

		Runnable printColumns = () -> {
			System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));
			System.out.print(' ');
			for (int i = 0; i < cols - 2; ++i) {
				System.out.print((char) ('A' + i));
			}
			System.out.println();
		};

		printColumns.run();

		for (int i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(String.format("%1$" + padLength + "s", i));
			} else {
				System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));
			}

			Arrays.stream(cells[i]).forEachOrdered(elem -> System.out.print(elem.toSingleChar()));

			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(i);
			}

			System.out.println();
		}

		printColumns.run();
	}

	public void fillBeginTile() {
		sourceCell.setFilled();
	}

	@NotNull
	private List<Coordinate> getTraversedCoords() {
		return new ArrayList<>(filledTiles);

	public void Map(int rows, int cols) {
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				cells[r][c] = new FillableCell();
			}
		}
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sourceInfo = generateStartCellInfo();
		Coordinate sourceCoord = sourceInfo.coord;
		Direction sourceDirection = sourceInfo.direction;
		sourceCell = new TerminationCell(sourceCoord, sourceDirection, true);
		cells[sourceCoord.row][sourceCoord.col] = sourceCell;
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sinkInfo = generateEndCellInfo();
		Coordinate sinkCoord = sinkInfo.coord;
		Direction sinkDirection = sinkInfo.direction;
		sinkCell = new TerminationCell(sinkCoord, sinkDirection, false);
		cells[sinkCoord.row][sinkCoord.col] = sinkCell;
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) {
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			System.arraycopy(cells[r], 0, this.cells[r], 0, cols);
		}
		sourceCell = null;
		sinkCell = null;
		int sourceCount = 0;
		int sinkCount = 0;
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				Cell cell = this.cells[r][c];
				if (cell instanceof TerminationCell termCell) {
					if (termCell.isSource()) {
						sourceCount++;
						sourceCell = termCell;
						if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source must not be on edge");
						}
						Direction dir = termCell.getDirection();
						Coordinate nextCoord = new Coordinate(r, c).add(dir.getOffset());
						if (isInBounds(nextCoord)) {
							Cell nextCell = this.cells[nextCoord.row][nextCoord.col];
							if (nextCell instanceof Wall) {
								throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source cannot point into a wall");
							}
						}
					} else {
						if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
							sinkCount++;
							sinkCell = termCell;
							Direction dir = termCell.getDirection();
							Coordinate nextCoord = new Coordinate(r, c).add(dir.getOffset());
							if (isInBounds(nextCoord)) {
								throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink must point outside the map");
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if (sourceCount != 1) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("There must be exactly one source cell");
		}
		if (sinkCount != 1) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("There must be exactly one sink cell");
		}
	}

	boolean tryPlacePipe(int row, int col, Pipe p) {
		int r = row - 1;
		int c = col - 1;
		if (r < 0 || r >= rows || c < 0 || c >= cols) {
			return false;
		}
		Cell targetCell = cells[r][c];
		if (targetCell instanceof FillableCell fillable && !fillable.isOccupied()) {
			fillable.setPipe(p);
			return true;
		}
		return false;
	}

	public void undo(final Coordinate coord) {
		int r = coord.row;
		int c = coord.col;
		if (!isInBounds(coord)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Coordinate out of bounds");
		}
		Cell currentCell = cells[r][c];
		if (!(currentCell instanceof FillableCell)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cell is not fillable");
		}
		cells[r][c] = new FillableCell();
		filledTiles.remove(coord);
	}

	public void fillTiles(int distance) {
		if (sourceCell == null) {
			return;
		}
		filledTiles.clear();
		Queue<Coordinate> queue = new LinkedList<>();
		Map<Coordinate, Integer> distanceMap = new HashMap<>();
		Coordinate start = sourceCell.coord;
		queue.offer(start);
		distanceMap.put(start, 0);
		filledTiles.add(start);
		cells[start.row][start.col].setFilled();
		while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
			Coordinate current = queue.poll();
			int currentDist = distanceMap.get(current);
			if (currentDist >= distance) {
				continue;
			}
			for (Direction dir : Direction.values()) {
				Coordinate neighbor = current.add(dir.getOffset());
				if (isInBounds(neighbor) && !filledTiles.contains(neighbor)) {
					Cell neighborCell = cells[neighbor.row][neighbor.col];
					if (!(neighborCell instanceof Wall)) {
						neighborCell.setFilled();
						filledTiles.add(neighbor);
						distanceMap.put(neighbor, currentDist + 1);
						queue.offer(neighbor);
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public boolean checkPath() {
		if (sourceCell == null || sinkCell == null) {
			return false;
		}
		Set<Coordinate> visited = new HashSet<>();
		Queue<Coordinate> queue = new LinkedList<>();
		queue.offer(sourceCell.coord);
		visited.add(sourceCell.coord);
		while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
			Coordinate current = queue.poll();
			if (current.equals(sinkCell.coord)) {
				return true;
			}
			Cell currentCell = cells[current.row][current.col];
			List<Direction> directions = new ArrayList<>();
			if (currentCell instanceof Pipe pipe) {
				directions.addAll(pipe.getConnectedDirections());
			} else if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell termCell) {
				directions.add(termCell.getDirection());
			} else {
				continue;
			}
			for (Direction dir : directions) {
				Coordinate neighbor = current.add(dir.getOffset());
				if (isInBounds(neighbor) && !visited.contains(neighbor)) {
					Cell neighborCell = cells[neighbor.row][neighbor.col];
					boolean connected = false;
					if (neighborCell instanceof Pipe neighborPipe) {
						if (neighborPipe.getConnectedDirections().contains(dir.getOpposite())) {
							connected = true;
						}
					} else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell neighborTerm) {
						if (neighborTerm.equals(sinkCell) && neighborTerm.getDirection() == dir) {
							connected = true;
						}
					}
					if (connected) {
						visited.add(neighbor);
						queue.offer(neighbor);
					}
				}
			}
		}
		return false;
	}
}
```

public boolean hasLost() {
    int currentFilledCount = filledTiles.size();
    boolean noNewTilesFilled = currentFilledCount == prevFilledTiles;
    // Update prevFilledTiles for the next round
    prevFilledTiles = currentFilledCount;
    return noNewTilesFilled;
}

The errors indicate that the `Map` class does not have a constructor with the signature `Map(int, int)` or `Map(int, int, Cell[][])`. In the provided code, the constructors are named `Map`, but in Java, constructors must be declared as `public Map(...)`, not with a return type, and the class name must match exactly. 

The issue is that the constructors are incorrectly declared as methods with a return type (probably `void`) instead of proper constructors. To fix this, the constructors should be declared as `public Map(...)` without a return type.

Here's the corrected `Map` class with proper constructors:

```java
package game.map;

import game.map.cells.Cell;
import game.map.cells.FillableCell;
import game.map.cells.TerminationCell;
import game.map.cells.Wall;
import game.pipes.Pipe;
import io.Deserializer;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import util.Coordinate;
import util.Direction;
import util.StringUtils;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * Map of the game.
 */
public class Map {

	private final int rows;
	private final int cols;
	@NotNull
	final Cell[][] cells;

	private TerminationCell sourceCell;
	private TerminationCell sinkCell;

	@NotNull
	private final Set<Coordinate> filledTiles = new HashSet<>();
	private int prevFilledTiles = 0;
	private Integer prevFilledDistance;

	/**
	 * Constructs a map from a map string.
	 * <p>
	 * This is a convenience method for unit testing.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @param rows     Number of rows.
	 * @param cols     Number of columns.
	 * @param cellsRep String representation of the map, with columns delimited by {@code '\n'}.
	 * @return A map with the cells set from {@code cellsRep}.
	 * @throws IllegalArgumentException If the map is incorrectly formatted.
	 */
	@NotNull
	static Map fromString(int rows, int cols, @NotNull String cellsRep) {
		var cells = Deserializer.parseString(rows, cols, cellsRep);
		return new Map(rows, cols, cells);
	}

	/**
	 * Constructor to initialize map with given size.
	 */
	public Map(int rows, int cols) {
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				cells[r][c] = new FillableCell();
			}
		}
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sourceInfo = generateStartCellInfo();
		Coordinate sourceCoord = sourceInfo.coord;
		Direction sourceDirection = sourceInfo.direction;
		sourceCell = new TerminationCell(sourceCoord, sourceDirection, true);
		cells[sourceCoord.row][sourceCoord.col] = sourceCell;
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sinkInfo = generateEndCellInfo();
		Coordinate sinkCoord = sinkInfo.coord;
		Direction sinkDirection = sinkInfo.direction;
		sinkCell = new TerminationCell(sinkCoord, sinkDirection, false);
		cells[sinkCoord.row][sinkCoord.col] = sinkCell;
	}

	/**
	 * Constructor to initialize map with given size and cell array.
	 */
	public Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) {
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			System.arraycopy(cells[r], 0, this.cells[r], 0, cols);
		}
		sourceCell = null;
		sinkCell = null;
		int sourceCount = 0;
		int sinkCount = 0;
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				Cell cell = this.cells[r][c];
				if (cell instanceof TerminationCell termCell) {
					if (termCell.isSource()) {
						sourceCount++;
						sourceCell = termCell;
						if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source must not be on edge");
						}
						Direction dir = termCell.getDirection();
						Coordinate nextCoord = new Coordinate(r, c).add(dir.getOffset());
						if (isInBounds(nextCoord)) {
							Cell nextCell = this.cells[nextCoord.row][nextCoord.col];
							if (nextCell instanceof Wall) {
								throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source cannot point into a wall");
							}
						}
					} else {
						if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
							sinkCount++;
							sinkCell = termCell;
							Direction dir = termCell.getDirection();
							Coordinate nextCoord = new Coordinate(r, c).add(dir.getOffset());
							if (isInBounds(nextCoord)) {
								throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink must point outside the map");
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if (sourceCount != 1) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("There must be exactly one source cell");
		}
		if (sinkCount != 1) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("There must be exactly one sink cell");
		}
	}

	// ... rest of the class remains unchanged
}
```

	static Map fromString(int rows, int cols, @NotNull String cellsRep) {
		var cells = Deserializer.parseString(rows, cols, cellsRep);
		return new Map(rows, cols, cells);
	}

	/**
	 * Constructor to initialize map with given size.
	 */
	public Map(int rows, int cols) {
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				cells[r][c] = new FillableCell();
			}
		}
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sourceInfo = generateStartCellInfo();
		Coordinate sourceCoord = sourceInfo.coord;
		Direction sourceDirection = sourceInfo.direction;
		sourceCell = new TerminationCell(sourceCoord, sourceDirection, true);
		cells[sourceCoord.row][sourceCoord.col] = sourceCell;
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sinkInfo = generateEndCellInfo();
		Coordinate sinkCoord = sinkInfo.coord;
		Direction sinkDirection = sinkInfo.direction;
		sinkCell = new TerminationCell(sinkCoord, sinkDirection, false);
		cells[sinkCoord.row][sinkCoord.col] = sinkCell;
	}

	/**
	 * Constructor to initialize map with given size and cell array.
	 */
	public Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) {
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			System.arraycopy(cells[r], 0, this.cells[r], 0, cols);
		}
		sourceCell = null;
		sinkCell = null;
		int sourceCount = 0;
		int sinkCount = 0;
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				Cell cell = this.cells[r][c];
				if (cell instanceof TerminationCell termCell) {
					if (termCell.isSource()) {
						sourceCount++;
						sourceCell = termCell;
						if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source must not be on edge");
						}
						Direction dir = termCell.getDirection();
						Coordinate nextCoord = new Coordinate(r, c).add(dir.getOffset());
						if (isInBounds(nextCoord)) {
							Cell nextCell = this.cells[nextCoord.row][nextCoord.col];
							if (nextCell instanceof Wall) {
								throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source cannot point into a wall");
							}
						}
					} else {
						if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
							sinkCount++;
							sinkCell = termCell;
							Direction dir = termCell.getDirection();
							Coordinate nextCoord = new Coordinate(r, c).add(dir.getOffset());
							if (isInBounds(nextCoord)) {
								throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink must point outside the map");
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if (sourceCount != 1) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("There must be exactly one source cell");
		}
		if (sinkCount != 1) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("There must be exactly one sink cell");
		}
	}
